glyph.isekai_mahou.pull.desc: Pulls the target toward you. With Invert, pushes it away.
glyph.isekai_mahou.break.desc: Mines the block it hits like a magic iron pickaxe (Amplify: diamond, netherite; Expand: area; Fortune and Silk Touch work). On creatures, cracks their armor.
glyph.isekai_mahou.harvest.desc: Harvests ripe crops around and replants them. Also shears sheep.
glyph.isekai_mahou.conjure_light.desc: Creates a temporary orb of magic light where it hits. On you: night vision; on others: glowing. With Invert: blinds and snuffs magic lights.
glyph.isekai_mahou.slow_fall.desc: The target falls slowly and takes no fall damage. With Invert: enemies lose their flight and plummet.
glyph.isekai_mahou.blink.desc: Teleports you up to 8 blocks where you look (or to the point hit) without going into walls. On an enemy, you appear behind it. With Invert: dash back.
glyph.isekai_mahou.shield.desc: Wraps the target in a barrier that absorbs damage (Amplify makes it stronger). With Invert: shatters enemy shields and absorption.
glyph.isekai_mahou.levitate.desc: Makes the target float upward. With Invert: slams the target into the ground.
glyph.isekai_mahou.place_block.desc: Places the block from your offhand where it hits. Without one, creates temporary Conjured Stone. Expand builds a platform or wall.
glyph.isekai_mahou.detect.desc: Reveals creatures within 24 blocks and highlights nearby ores through walls (only you see them).
glyph.isekai_mahou.stun.desc: Freezes the target in place, unable to strike, and interrupts its casting. With Invert: frees from stun, roots, ice and slowness.
glyph.isekai_mahou.mark_target.desc: The target becomes Exposed and glows: it takes more damage from spells and also from players' hits and arrows. With Invert: removes the mark.
glyph.isekai_mahou.swap.desc: You and the target swap places.
glyph.isekai_mahou.recall.desc: 1st use: marks the spot (you or the point hit). 2nd use: returns you to the mark, in the same dimension. With Invert: moves the mark without returning.
glyph.isekai_mahou.reflect.desc: Projectiles and spells that hit the target fly back at whoever shot them. With Invert: removes an enemy's reflection.
glyph.isekai_mahou.telekinesis.desc: Holds mobs and items at the point you look at for a few seconds (sneak to release). With Invert: hurls them.
glyph.isekai_mahou.silence.desc: Prevents the target (player or creature) from casting spells and interrupts its casting. With Invert: removes silence.
glyph.isekai_mahou.disarm.desc: Mobs drop the weapon in their hand; players can't use their held item for a few seconds and their hits are weakened.
glyph.isekai_mahou.shrink.desc: Shrinks the target: smaller and weaker. Undoes Grow. With Invert: grows it.
glyph.isekai_mahou.grow.desc: Enlarges the target: bigger, stronger and with more reach. Undoes Shrink. With Invert: shrinks enemies.
glyph.isekai_mahou.mana_gift.desc: Transfers part of your mana to an ally. On your summons, heals them a little.
glyph.isekai_mahou.dispel.desc: Removes good effects from enemies and destroys nearby enemy spells. On yourself or with Allies Only: removes bad effects. On a block: undoes magic barriers and Conjured Stone.
glyph.isekai_mahou.mana_drain.desc: Steals mana from the target. Creatures take damage and can't cast for a moment.
glyph.isekai_mahou.haste_time.desc: The target becomes much faster at running, mining and attacking. With Sensitive, speeds up time for blocks (plants grow). With Invert: slows.
glyph.isekai_mahou.slow_time.desc: The target becomes very slow and nearby projectiles almost stop. With Invert: hastes.
glyph.isekai_mahou.counterspell.desc: Counters pending casts on the Stack at the target (telegraphed attacks, charging spells) using the spell power, silences and destroys nearby enemy spells. Minor/Major need power 0.5/1.0; Supreme needs 2 (Amplify, Charge). On yourself: a pulse that counters everything within 8 blocks.
glyph.isekai_mahou.on_hurt.desc: Trigger: the spell casts itself whenever you take damage (if you have mana and it isn't on cooldown).
glyph.isekai_mahou.on_low_health.desc: Trigger: the spell casts itself when your health drops below 30%.
glyph.isekai_mahou.on_kill.desc: Trigger: the spell casts itself when you kill a creature.
glyph.isekai_mahou.on_crit.desc: Trigger: the spell casts itself when you land a critical hit (sword or arrow).
glyph.isekai_mahou.then.desc: Trigger: after this spell, casts the spell in the next loadout slot.
glyph.isekai_mahou.together.desc: Trigger: also casts the spell in the next loadout slot at the same time (if it has a cast time, you start casting it right away).
message.isekai_mahou.arcane_reactive_onl: This spell is reactive: it fires by itself when its trigger happens.
message.isekai_mahou.arcane_recall_dimen: Your mark is in another dimension.
message.isekai_mahou.arcane_too_hard: This block is too hard for your magic.
